_comment: Example only: copy the parts you need into bin/appsettings.json, or supply the same keys as environment variables (Agent__Backup__Staging__AgentDirectory, ...). Contains no secrets: SQL Server credentials are injected as BACKUP_AGENT_SECRET_<reference> environment variables, never stored here.

Staging.AgentDirectory: <directory SQL Server writes backups to and this agent reads and deletes>

LocalStorage.RootDirectory: <directory for backups stored on this machine>

Volumes.external-ssd: <absolute directory of an extra disk; the UI selects it by this name>

CentralStorage.RootDirectory: <directory of the central storage as seen from this machine>
